notes.title: Halve DEMO Patch Notes V0.3.7
notes.notes:
Next Fest has officially begun, and together with that, we have released a new update for the Demo!
Once again, huge thanks for your feedback, it's helping us shape the game for the better!!

- Reworked both character hands orbs VFX - better visuals and performance!

- Entering the cave at the end of each level will now automatically trigger the level end sequence.

- Steam Deck improvements: disabled unnecessary graphics settings, fixed UI navigation with D-Pad issues and B (cancel) button not working for UI navigation, and disabled touchscreen controls.

- Increased UI Sliders step value, as some of you had issues changing the audio while using joysticks

- Fixed Brightness setting not being visually reflected in the Main Menu.

- Fixed music disappearance when coming back to the Main Menu from any level.

- Fixed Steam session not exiting properly for some players on Windows 11.

- Some small overall performance improvements.



Have fun with the Demo!

notes.title: Halve DEMO Patch Notes v0.3.6
notes.notes:
Thank you for the feedback and bug reports so far! Here are the first demo patch notes:

- Slightly adjusted camera framing for square-ish displays to follow the players better (4:3 aspect ratio).
- Mouse cursor is now hidden while in-game
- The final demo challenge sequence no longer loses its awesome music when skipping the cutscene.
- Fixed characters sometimes sliding on the ground and losing their movement animations after a cutscene.
- Fixed Graphics Screen Resolution settings having duplicate entries.
- Fixed an edge case where the collected secrets count would get reset (Sorry for that! You can now search for all the secrets successfully, hopefully 👀).
- Fixed an issue that breaks/freezes the game when returning to the main menu screen while in the level restart sequence

Let us know if you notice any more issues or have any suggestions on what we could adjust! Thanks, and have fun with the demo!

notes.title: Halve Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello adventure seekers!

We have some exciting news for you today - we have finally decided to release Halve Steam demo on April 21st!

The Demo will consist of two chapters, where you will be able to experience a variety of mind-bending challenges in the world of Halve. If you're curious to see all the content that will be available, it should take you up to half an hour to complete all of the demo levels.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1906430/extras/Environments.gif?t=1678549909

Here are some of the features that will be included in the first Demo version:

 Simultaneous movement of two characters - control both of the spirits at the same time by using the same movement keys to navigate through the world!
 Two environments - Forest and Ruins. Both environments will allow you to experience hand-crafted challenging levels and beautiful scenery!
 Unique character abilities - the final game will consist of many different and unique character abilities, and so during the Demo, you will be able to use two of these powers to solve more difficult challenges!
 Up to 20 short levels, where every level will introduce you to different possible encounters of Halve!
 Three mesmerizing and original soundtracks - Main game theme, Forest and Ruins chapters.
 And some additional features as well! (That I don't want to spoil you guys, so I'm not going to mention them here, haha!)

And for this occasion, we have opened up a Discord server! You are more than welcome to join if you'd like to give us any kind of feedback, or just chat about anything game related!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941412/e370168dd8e07bc2fdae99cf7f1c9c0ee81cc73e.png

Talk to you soon! 
Cheers!
- The Moonleaf studio team
